We absolutely need proper examples and/or sources otherwise the method may as well be undocumented like `ScriptLanguageExtension::_get_documentation()` (which is quite tragic) and prone to become unutilized.

I am genuinely vehemently against _exposing_ a method returning this **Dictionary** in **EditorPlugin** and calling it a day. If we want users to fetch the class documentation it would be much more ideal to [expose a API for it](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/12531), with proper methods to ensure it's stable and type-safe.
I am aware that, as you've said, we already use this format elsewhere, but it's... not clean, not stable, feels like a hack. The method returns everything there is to know about any given class, which can be quite slow and is excessive in most use cases.

- https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/12531
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/10339

body:
In my opinion, exposing the documentation as a `Dictionary` is fine, given that this functionality is rarely needed, is already exposed in the virtual method `ScriptLanguageExtension::_get_documentation()`, and for `DocData` structures, we strive to maintain compatibility when converting to/from `Dictionary`.

I think creating a "more robust" API is overkill in this case. Since we don't have structs in the type system, the only choice is between a dictionary (in the spirit of `get_property_list()` and some other methods) and a complex API consisting of multiple classes/methods. But the machine-readable access to documentation is rarely needed and isn't that important, even if we accidentally break compatibility at some point.

In my opinion, the only question is how to document the dictionary structure. A full description is somewhat cumbersome. Should we include it, or could we just add a link to the source code?

We should probably add the `get_documentation_class_list()` method, otherwise users won't be able to get the full list of existing classes (what to pass as the `class_name` parameter (except for `ClassBD` classes). We should also probably expose the [`Script::get_doc_class_name()`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/1aabcb9e9bc7a222a972731523831ec86b77ee20/core/object/script_language.h#L162) method.

Alternatively, we could change the return type to `Array[Dictionary]` and remove the `class_name` parameter (returning all documentation, not just for a specific class). But this probably isn't very good from a performance and usability perspective.
